notes:
Saying "it's 4k" no longer starts a 4K render.

Crisp understood "it is 4k" as you describing your file, but "it's 4k" — the way most people write it — slipped through and began a full upscale of a clip that needed nothing done to it. Both are read the same way now. Asking for the change still works exactly as before: "make it 4k" upscales.
